papers.title: Neurobehavioural, Biochemical and Histological Effects of Metformin in a Scopolamine-Induced Cognitive Impairment Model in Male Wistar Rats
papers.reason: The rat study links pharmacologically induced spatial working-memory impairment to prefrontal and hippocampal pathology, although its primary focus is metformin efficacy rather than executive-function mechanisms.

papers.title: Silent brain infarction is associated with executive dysfunction in community-dwelling older adults: the Sefuri-Yoshinogari study.
papers.reason: This large human study directly associates MRI-detected silent brain infarction with Stroop-defined executive dysfunction in older adults without dementia.

papers.title: Seeing and deciding to help: Neural and attentional mechanisms of prosociality in younger and older adults.
papers.reason: The study combines eye tracking and fMRI to characterize age-related attention and cognitive-control recruitment, but these mechanisms are examined primarily in prosocial decision-making.

papers.title: A novel multi-modal fusion framework based on simultaneous EEG-fNIRS for the classification of working memory loads
papers.reason: The paper directly addresses multimodal EEG-fNIRS classification of human working-memory load, closely matching neurophysiological cognitive assessment methodology.

papers.title: Dissociating stimulus and task effects on neural oscillations during n-back tasks
papers.reason: Systematic manipulation of n-back protocols reveals separable frontal-theta and centroparietal-alpha signatures of working-memory encoding and task structure.

papers.title: Mindful Breath: A Comprehensive Literature Review and Comparative Analysis of Breathwork Techniques
papers.reason: The review focuses on autonomic, emotional, and general health effects of breathwork, with only incidental references to cognition and EEG rhythms.

papers.title: Increasing daily step count in mild cognitive impairment: a 12-month randomised controlled trial
papers.reason: The trial includes spatial working-memory and global cognition outcomes in MCI, but its main contribution concerns a physical-activity intervention rather than executive-function modelling or measurement.

papers.title: A home-finding task in virtual reality to test entorhinal path integration performance in patients with mild cognitive impairment
papers.reason: The immersive behavioral task distinguishes MCI from healthy aging through path-integration errors and offers a promising digital marker for early cognitive impairment.

papers.title: Foster care intervention protects cognitive control skills in young adults exposed to institutional rearing.
papers.reason: Flanker behavior, ERPs, and time-frequency EEG provide direct evidence about lasting environmental effects on performance monitoring and cognitive control.

papers.title: Writing is thinking: toward a neuropsychological model of scientific writing as knowledge construction
papers.reason: The paper proposes a testable human cognitive architecture integrating executive control, working memory, metacognitive monitoring, and predictive coding, although it is conceptual rather than quantitative.

papers.title: Post-Stroke Cognitive Impairment in Georgia: Diagnostic Utility of Georgian NINDS-CSN Neuropsychological Battery
papers.reason: The study validates a multidomain clinical battery that includes executive measures for post-stroke impairment, but emphasizes conventional screening accuracy rather than process modelling or digital biomarkers.

papers.title: REM sleep suppression after penetrating traumatic brain injury is associated with alterations in the supramammillary-hippocampal circuit.
papers.reason: The rat study characterizes REM-related theta and hippocampal circuit disruption after injury, but it does not directly assess planning, working memory, attention, or cognitive control.

papers.title: Adaptation and Validation of Brief Tablet-Based Cognitive Assessment Tool in Uganda
papers.reason: This large validation study evaluates a scalable tablet battery covering memory and executive function for detecting objective cognitive impairment in an underserved population.

papers.title: Neural signatures of auditory distraction and cognitive demand during working memory performance
papers.reason: The study directly identifies EEG power, asymmetry, and connectivity signatures of distraction and time pressure during human working-memory performance.

papers.title: Kinestesia: the prefrontal EEG response to a cognitive-motor intervention is graded by baseline cognitive status
papers.reason: Resting-state prefrontal EEG changes distinguish intervention responses along the healthy-to-MCI spectrum, although the uncontrolled sample is very small.

papers.title: Multimodal neuromonitoring-guided cerebral protection and early neurocognitive outcomes after aortic arch surgery
papers.reason: The study combines EEG and vascular monitoring to predict broad postoperative cognitive outcomes, but does not specifically characterize executive-function processes or task-based biomarkers.

papers.title: P300 latency prolongation and executive dysfunction in systemic sclerosis: A multimodal cognitive assessment
papers.reason: The paper closely matches multimodal clinical assessment by combining auditory P300 with computerized Stroop performance to detect executive dysfunction in patients versus controls.

papers.title: Network-targeted neurophysiological biomarkers of dysconnectivity and cognitive decline in Alzheimer’s disease
papers.reason: Network-targeted TMS-EEG markers classify MCI, relate selectively to executive function, and predict longitudinal executive decline across the Alzheimer’s continuum.

papers.title: Magnetic Resonance Imaging-Defined Cerebral Small Vessel Disease Burden and Longitudinal Neuropsychiatric and Functional Recovery After Stroke: A Prospective Cohort Study.
papers.reason: The study monitors global cognition after stroke but focuses on depression and functional recovery and finds no independent association between small-vessel burden and cognitive impairment.

papers.title: Distinct brain activation patterns linked to clinical symptoms during hand grasping in Parkinson's disease
papers.reason: The fNIRS analysis concerns cortical activation during motor grasping, with cognition included only as a clinical covariate that showed no significant association.

papers.title: Evolution and interrelation of physical frailty and mild cognitive impairment up to two years after kidney transplantation: a multi-center prospective cohort study
papers.reason: The cohort tracks MoCA-defined impairment and frailty after transplantation but does not examine executive-function mechanisms or specialized cognitive biomarkers.

papers.title: Cognitive function, anxiety, and depression in patients newly diagnosed with thyroid cancer in China
papers.reason: This is a broad MoCA-based prevalence and correlates study without specific measures or models of executive function.

papers.title: Cognitive Physiology in Healthy Young Adults: Links to Ciliary Neurotrophic Factor and Retinal Biomarkers
papers.reason: The study explores retinal and plasma markers for low global cognitive scores, but it neither targets executive function nor validates impairment classification in a clinical sample.

papers.title: Anticipated distractor processing relies on distinct representational states before and after distractor onset in visual working memory
papers.reason: Human EEG decoding provides detailed mechanistic evidence that anticipatory coding and post-onset representational reformatting make distinct contributions to distractor control in visual working memory.

papers.title: Impact of Recording Conditions and Feature Fusion on Dementia Classification Using Spectral, Entropy, and Complexity EEG Features
papers.reason: The paper directly evaluates EEG feature families and recording conditions for differential classification of healthy controls, MCI, and Alzheimer’s disease.

papers.title: Relationship Between Cognitive Performance and Anthropometric Status, Dietary Diversity, and Diet Quality in Older Turkish Adults: A Cross-Sectional Study
papers.reason: The study relates diet and body mass index to global MoCA scores without specifically assessing executive function or developing a cognitive biomarker.

papers.title: Correlation of Serum Malondialdehyde with Motor Severity and Cognitive Function in Parkinson’s Disease
papers.reason: The association between oxidative stress and abnormal Trail Making Test B performance is relevant to executive dysfunction, but it is a small correlational biomarker study centered on Parkinsonian pathology.

papers.title: Dual-Task Performance as a Potential Digital Biomarker of Aging: Age-Stratified Reference Patterns Across the Adult Lifespan
papers.reason: The standardized digital paradigm quantifies age-related cognitive-motor interference and provides reference values for a potentially scalable attention and control biomarker, but lacks clinical validation.

papers.title: Resting-State EEG Microstate Dynamics as Neurophysiological Biomarkers Across the Alzheimer’s Disease Continuum: A Systematic Review
papers.reason: The review synthesizes resting-state EEG microstate alterations across subjective decline, MCI, and Alzheimer’s disease, while emphasizing substantial heterogeneity and limited biomarker confirmation.

papers.title: Feasibility of remote self-administered cognitive assessment in an Alzheimer’s disease treatment clinic
papers.reason: The study supports the practical deployment of remote digital cognitive testing across impairment levels, but evaluates completion feasibility rather than executive-function validity or diagnostic performance.

papers.title: Applications of Virtual Reality in Psychiatry. Systematic Review of the Scientific Literature
papers.reason: The broad psychiatry review mentions VR-based ADHD assessment and cognitive rehabilitation, but executive-function assessment is peripheral to its main focus on therapeutic applications.

papers.title: Cognitive Function, Mental Health, and Quality of Life in Leprosy: A Narrative Review
papers.reason: This review concerns cognitive outcomes in a human clinical population but does not specifically indicate findings on executive function, computational modelling, or digital biomarkers.
